visualReview.notes: Inspected current source, shared-material, medium-fi and actual retained-terrain renders in the same authoring round. Dated 2010 roofless cella with six free-standing Corinthian porch columns, projecting shaft brackets, open pedimented side windows, attached pilasters, gated doorway, surviving horizontal cornice, closed stepped podium and a small selected fallen block/drum group. Corrected a coarse brick-pattern material mismatch on smooth shafts by reusing raw sandstone instead; retained larger masonry joints in geometry. No complete ancient roof or pediment is invented.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Two reused 256² graphs: raw sandstone and standing-seam metal. Metric UVs, neutral linear sandstone tints, no embedded images or model-specific atlas. Sandstone supports separate tint roles while sharing its baked texture; at most three draws and one read per material graph. Separate GPU streams; eviction releases geometry. Flat/shared context exposes buried bases and is not proof of native-grade contact.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected 24 current medium-fi views: noon/late, Economy/High, street/block/skyline, silhouette, three details, four explicit levels and transitions. Triangle levels: 976 / 2988 / 7812 / 8676. Initial skyline-plus-district geometry 407,964 bytes. The roofless block and six-shaft porch persist at distance; window reveals, pilasters, brackets and simplified capitals resolve nearer. Physical laptop/phone and dense-city timing remain pending.
